## 61a55c0c7ee8

**Classification: reproduced generator-domain defect.** Audited source SHA-256: `10228dbc936bcfaf883caea789322b4fe0fcb41419ed9d6b238a917b47de37d3`.

The generator reserves color 9 as the maroon anchor marker, but its template source pool is `[1..9]` and therefore also samples 9. The exact canonical Racket rule treats every color-9 cell above the legend as an anchor and excludes every color-9 cell from the template. When 9 is selected as a source color, template cells become false anchors and the intended template loses those cells at genuine anchors.

`checks/audit/61a55c0c7ee8/probe.py` sampled seeds `0..99` and sample indices `0..5`: **190/600** generated inputs used 9 as a legend source. The retained generated witness is `seed=0`, `sample_index=0`, default difficulty. It belongs to the documented generator path, passes `self_check`, and was executed through the exact bundled Racket authority. The exact output and a role-aware interpretation of the stated template/anchor rule differ at **11 cells**; all inputs, outputs, inferred roles, hashes, and runtime identity are in `checks/audit/61a55c0c7ee8/report.json`.

The independent strict audit preset also failed because this target declares no executable semantic contract; it has no task-local tests. See `checks/audit/61a55c0c7ee8/combined/` and `check.log`. I did not edit the audited target.
